heading: Access to buildings and provision of access lanes, etc., on site of new building
content:
5.
Access to buildings and provision of access lanes, etc., on site of new building
(1)
Every building shall be provided with means of obtaining access thereto from a street.
(2)
The Building Authority may require the provision of an access lane or access road within the site of any new building.
(G.N.A. 83 of 1959)
